instructions: Heat the oven to 350°F. Line a baking sheet with foil.
Split the croissants lengthwise and set them on the sheet, cut side up.
In a small bowl, stir the cream cheese and Dijon together until smooth.
Spread the cream cheese mixture over the bottom halves.
Layer the ham and a slice of Swiss cheese on each bottom half, and close with the top halves.
Bake for 12 to 15 minutes, until the cheese has melted and the croissants are crisp at the edges.
method_notes: Six Sisters' Stuff (the lead, 5.0 from 1 rating) splits bakery croissants, spreads them with cream cheese and Dijon, fills them with ham and Swiss or cheddar and bakes them at 350°F; it also says they can be put together in the morning and baked later. Hungry Healthy Happy glazes with honey and Dijon, adds spinach and bakes 7 to 8 minutes. Neither has 20 ratings, so this is a fallback lead. The list says warmed for ten minutes, but the lead takes 12 to 15 minutes in the oven.
